# Contact & Support

Need help beyond this documentation? Use the channels below so the right people can assist you quickly.

## 7.1 Primary Contacts

- **General inquiries:** send email via `repuragent.uu@gmail.com`
- Product roadmap & feature ideas: Open a GitHub issue in the [public GitHub Repo](https://github.com/pharmbio/repuragent/issues) |

## 7.2 When Filing GitHub Issues

Include:
1. **Edition** (local Docker vs hosted web vs self-hosted `repuragent-web/`).
2. **Exact commit/branch** if you’re running from source.
3. **Reproduction steps** (commands, prompts, uploaded files).
4. **Relevant logs** (`docker-compose logs -f repuragent`, PostgreSQL errors, etc.).
5. **Environment details** (OS, Docker version, API key provider limits).

The maintainers triage issues weekly; urgent blocking bugs can be escalated via email.
